parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the number of protons and the number of neutrons in the nucleus of bismuth-212.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The $\gamma$-radiation emitted from the nucleus has a wavelength of $3.8\,\mathrm{pm}$.
Calculate the frequency of this radiation.

(Hz)

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain how a single beam of $\alpha$-particles and $\gamma$-radiation may be separated into a beam of $\alpha$-particles and a beam of $\gamma$-radiation.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The $\alpha$-particle emitted from the bismuth nucleus has an initial kinetic energy of $9.3 \times 10^{-13}\,\mathrm{J}$.
As the $\alpha$-particle moves through air it causes the removal of electrons from atoms. The $\alpha$-particle loses energy and is stopped after removing $1.8 \times 10^{5}$ electrons as it moves through the air.
Determine the energy, in eV, needed to remove one electron.

(eV)
